Class CraftingJobToast<T,M>

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.toast.CraftingJobToast<T,M>
Type Parameters:
T - The instance type.

All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.gui.components.toasts.Toast
public class CraftingJobToast<T,M> extends Object implements net.minecraft.client.gui.components.toasts.Toast
A toast that shows an ingredient icon alongside a title and a wrapping subtitle. Toasts with an equal token replace each other instead of being queued, so the token determines how toasts are grouped.
